id: 05_Lesson 3 How to Produce High-Quality Weld Beads
title: 手持激光焊接：焊出好焊缝（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/05_Lesson 3 How to Produce High-Quality Weld Beads.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/05_Lesson 3 How to Produce High-Quality Weld Beads（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 这一课：牢固、美观、不变形
points.K21: 技巧二三：45度，丝尖对红光
points.S2: 激光受控区与旁人防护
points.S3: 工件用夹具，手不进光路

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接台旁，台上摆着三块焊好的样件，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a welding bench with three neatly welded metal samples and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：手持激光焊，怎么焊得好。
overlay: 手持激光焊接：焊出好焊缝

shots.scene: 点、线、鱼鳞纹三种焊缝图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a row of dots, a smooth continuous line, and an overlapping fish scale pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 点焊、连续焊、脉冲焊，各有用处。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一块焊歪、发黑的工件发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a welded metal corner that is crooked and blackened, looking frustrated.
shots.narration: 阿杰焊的角件，又歪又发黑。

shots.scene: 阿杰徒手扶着工件准备焊，老李伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to weld while holding the workpiece with his bare hand; the facility engineer reaches out to stop him.
shots.narration: 他还想用手扶着工件焊。

shots.scene: 老李把工件夹进台钳，递给阿杰手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clamps the workpiece in a bench vise and hands the young male student a pair of welding gloves.
shots.narration: 老李说：先固定好，再讲技巧。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 准备、模式、技巧，一步步来。

shots.section_title: 这一课：牢固、美观、不变形
shots.scene: 牢固、美观、不变形三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a strong chain link, a shiny star and a straight ruler next to a flat metal sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 目标：焊缝牢固、美观、不变形。
overlay: 这一课：牢固、美观、不变形

shots.scene: 台面上摆着台钳、焊接面罩、焊接服、手套、防护眼镜和工件
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: a bench vise, a welding face shield, a welding jacket, leather gloves, laser safety goggles and metal workpieces. No people.
shots.narration: 备好焊接台、焊接服、眼镜、面罩、手套。

shots.scene: 空白参数表旁两个气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank recommendation table next to two gas cylinder icons with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 按推荐表设保护气，可用氮气或氩气。

shots.scene: 按住握持键和扳机，屏幕状态页上压力读数跳动
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses the grip button and trigger while a blank gauge on the touchscreen status page shows a moving needle.
shots.narration: 在状态页通气，看实际气压。

shots.scene: 蓝手套举着保护镜片对光检查
shots.prompt_en: Blue-gloved hands hold a round lens protector up to the light to inspect it.
shots.narration: 镜片脏了坏了，功率会降、焊不好。

shots.scene: 屏幕参考值与焊接嘴刻度对照
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank value box on the touchscreen and the graduated tube on the welding head with a matching arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接嘴刻度，对准焦距参考值。

shots.scene: 粗细不同的焊丝盘对应宽窄不同的焊缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thin, medium and thick wire spools lined up with narrow, medium and wide weld seams. No people.
shots.narration: 焊缝越宽、板越厚，焊丝越粗。

shots.scene: 很薄的板和窄缝，旁边焊丝盘打叉
shots.prompt_en: A very thin metal sheet with a narrow seam, next to a wire spool icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 很薄的板、很窄的缝，可以不填丝。

shots.scene: 焊丝和工件两个图标用等号相连
shots.prompt_en: A wire spool icon and a metal plate icon joined by an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝材质要和工件匹配。

shots.scene: 焊丝从焊接嘴侧槽伸出，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding wire running through the groove of the copper welding nozzle, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝要卡在焊接嘴的槽里。

shots.scene: 无尘布蘸酒精擦焊缝，旁边打磨机和清洗嘴图标
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wipes the seam area with a lint-free cloth; beside it icons of a small grinder and a cleaning nozzle. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 焊前清掉油污灰尘，三种方法都行。

shots.scene: 焊缝表面干燥发亮，钟表图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean, dry, shiny seam area with a small clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 擦完等它干了，再开始焊。

shots.scene: 触摸屏高级模式里三个空白模式按钮
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen showing three blank mode buttons with dot, line and fish scale icons. No people.
shots.narration: 高级模式里，有三种焊接模式。

shots.scene: 一束短光在一点上留下小圆点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short burst of light leaves a small round dot weld at one point between two plates. No people.
shots.narration: 点焊：短短出一次光，焊一个点。

shots.scene: 两块板先在两端点焊固定
shots.prompt_en: Two metal plates held in a jig with two small tack dots at both ends of the joint. No people.
shots.narration: 常用来打定位点，先把工件固定。

shots.scene: 薄五角星片点焊在圆板上
shots.prompt_en: A thin star-shaped metal piece fixed onto a round plate by several small tack dots. No people.
shots.narration: 也适合很薄的小零件。

shots.scene: 优点和缺点两栏图标
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: on the left icons of a target, a flat ruler and a sparkle with green checks; on the right a weak chain link with a red mark. No people.
shots.narration: 精度高变形小，但不够牢。

shots.scene: 触摸屏点焊参数页，空白数值格
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen tack welding page with a row of blank value boxes and plus and minus buttons. No people.
shots.narration: 设好参数，确认后启用出光。

shots.scene: 工件夹在台钳上，红光对准焊点
shots.prompt_en: A star-shaped piece and round plate clamped in a small jig on a vise; a red aiming dot sits on the joint. No people.
shots.narration: 点焊不用焊丝，红光对准就焊。

shots.scene: 发黑处用布蘸酒精擦净
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wipes a small dark mark beside a tack weld with a cloth.
shots.narration: 焊点发黑，用酒精或水擦掉。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上出光开关被关闭，红圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A finger switches off the laser toggle on the touchscreen, circled in red. No people besides the finger.
shots.narration: 焊完关掉出光，防止误出光。

shots.scene: 功率滑块：高—焊得深，低—外观好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a power slider: at the high end a deep weld icon, at the low end a neat shiny weld icon. No people.
shots.narration: 功率大焊得深，功率小更好看。

shots.scene: 时间滑块和一个专业模式齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A time slider and a gear icon for finer settings. No people.
shots.narration: 点焊时间也能调，还可精细设置。

shots.scene: 连续光束沿缝走出一条连续焊缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a continuous beam moves along a seam leaving a smooth unbroken weld line. No people.
shots.narration: 连续焊：光不停，焊缝连成一条线。

shots.scene: 水管和车架横梁两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a water pipe joint and a vehicle chassis beam. No people.
shots.narration: 要承重、要密封的地方用它。

shots.scene: 优点、缺点两栏图标
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: icons of a strong beam and a sealed pipe with green checks; icons of a burnt-through thin plate and a warped sheet with red marks. No people.
shots.narration: 牢固密封，但薄板易烧穿、易变形。

shots.scene: 屏幕切到连续焊，出光和送丝两个开关打开
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen switched to the continuous mode, with laser and wire feed toggles both on. No people.
shots.narration: 切到连续焊，启用出光和送丝。

shots.scene: 两块板定位成略大于直角，焊后收缩成直角
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two plates set at a slightly open angle before welding, then pulled into a right angle after welding by shrinkage arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 热胀冷缩会把角拉小。

shots.scene: 点焊图标旁边角度符号打勾
shots.prompt_en: A tack dot icon beside a right angle symbol with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 点焊热量小，不用预留角度。

shots.scene: 长工件上均匀分布几个定位点
shots.prompt_en: A long seam with several small tack dots spaced evenly along it. No people.
shots.narration: 先打定位点，长件中间多加几个。

shots.scene: 拇指把焊接头上的送丝开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a gloved thumb sliding the wire feed switch on the welding head to off.
shots.narration: 关掉送丝开关，就能当点焊用。

shots.scene: 拇指把送丝开关拨回开
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a gloved thumb sliding the wire feed switch back to on.
shots.narration: 切回连续焊，记得打开开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰检查夹好的工件位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear checks the position of plates clamped in a vise before welding.
shots.narration: 焊前再确认位置，焊完就改不了。

shots.scene: 焊接头从起点到终点一路焊过去的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the welding head moving from a start mark to an end mark along the seam in one smooth arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 从起点一口气焊到终点。

shots.scene: 焊丝偏离路径的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of the wire tip drifting off the seam line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝不能偏离焊缝。

shots.scene: 手往后拽焊接头的图标打叉，旁边自动后退箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand yanking the welding head backward crossed out in red, next to a small arrow showing the head moving back by itself. No people.
shots.narration: 别往后拽，焊丝会推着它走。

shots.scene: 功率、宽度、频率、送丝速度四个滑块
shots.prompt_en: Four blank sliders with icons: power, width, frequency and wire speed. No people.
shots.narration: 要更牢加功率，要少发黑减功率。

shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上微调滑块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts sliders on the touchscreen while looking at a test weld.
shots.narration: 宽度、频率、送丝速度也能调。

shots.scene: 点状熔池一个叠一个，形成鱼鳞纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of round molten dots overlapping one after another to form a fish scale weld pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 脉冲焊：点状熔池叠成鱼鳞纹。

shots.scene: 薄板图标，位于点焊和连续焊之间的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A thin plate icon placed on an arrow between a dot icon and a line icon. No people.
shots.narration: 介于点焊和连续焊之间。

shots.scene: 优点和缺点两栏图标
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: icons of a flat sheet, a shiny mirror plate and a curvy seam with green checks; an icon of tiny gaps with a red mark. No people.
shots.narration: 变形小、能焊反光料，密封差一些。

shots.scene: 屏幕切到脉冲焊，默认参数
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen switched to pulse mode with default blank values and a small speedometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用默认参数，速度会影响纹路。

shots.scene: 阿杰在挡光帘后脉冲焊，不加焊丝
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear pulse-welds a clamped seam without filler wire behind a laser safety curtain.
shots.narration: 也可以不加丝，不必预留角度。

shots.scene: 翻过工件看背面，平整无痕，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the welded plate over; the back side is flat and clean, with a green check.
shots.narration: 背面无痕无变形，就是成功。

shots.scene: 工件直接平放在台面上焊的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a workpiece lying flat on the welding table being welded, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别直接在焊台上焊，会焊在台上。

shots.scene: 工件被台钳夹起，焊缝悬空
shots.prompt_en: The workpiece is clamped in a vise so the seam is raised above the table surface, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 把焊接区架空再焊。

shots.section_title: 技巧二三：45度，丝尖对红光
shots.scene: 焊接嘴与焊缝成45度角的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the welding nozzle meeting the seam at a forty-five degree angle, with an angle arc. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接嘴与焊缝成四十五度。
overlay: 技巧二三：45度，丝尖对红光

shots.section_title: 技巧二三：45度，丝尖对红光
shots.scene: 丝尖碰到工件，红点落在焊位
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the wire tip touching the workpiece and a red aiming dot on the weld position. No people.
shots.narration: 丝尖碰工件，红光落在焊位上。

shots.scene: 焊完立即抬起焊接头的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the welding head lifting away from the seam right after the weld ends, with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 焊完马上抬起，防止粘丝。

shots.scene: 硬拽、左右晃焊接头的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a welding head stuck to the workpiece being yanked and wiggled, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 粘住了别硬拽，也别左右晃。

shots.scene: 关送丝开关，焊接头朝着工件，再出一次光同时抬起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire switch set to off, then a short pulse while the head, still pointed at the workpiece, lifts away. No people.
shots.narration: 关送丝，再出一次光同时抬起。

shots.scene: 屏幕板厚选项选小一档，焊缝发亮
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen thickness selector moved one step lower, next to a bright, clean weld icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不求高强度，板厚可设小一点。

shots.scene: 黑边用清洗嘴清理干净
shots.prompt_en: A weld edge with dark marks is cleaned by the cleaning nozzle until shiny. No people.
shots.narration: 已经有黑边，用清洗嘴清理。

shots.scene: 焊接头不出光，屏幕上联锁指示灯为红
shots.prompt_en: The welding head shows no output; a touchscreen status light for the safety interlock is red. No people.
shots.narration: 不出光，多半是联锁没闭合。

shots.scene: 出光开关和联锁图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a laser enable toggle and a closed loop chain symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 或者没打开出光开关。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标环绕两个开关
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon around the laser toggle and the interlock loop symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 这些都是保护人的安全机制。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：准备、模式、技巧
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards in a row with icons of a checklist, three weld patterns and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 准备六步、三种模式、六条技巧。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰发空白授权卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank authorization card to the young male student after a training session.
shots.narration: 培训考核、授权后才能上手焊。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区与旁人防护
shots.scene: 焊接工位四周挡光帘，门上激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A welding booth surrounded by laser safety curtains, with a laser warning sign on the closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 在有屏障的激光受控区里焊。
overlay: 激光受控区与旁人防护

shots.section_title: 激光受控区与旁人防护
shots.scene: 粉紫色强光和反射示意，旁观者戴防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of bright reflected light from a shiny weld; the female graduate student watching nearby wears laser safety goggles.
shots.narration: 反光也伤眼，旁边的人也要戴镜。

shots.section_title: 激光受控区与旁人防护
shots.scene: 焊接头指向人的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a welding head pointed at a person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接头永远不要对着人。

shots.section_title: 工件用夹具，手不进光路
shots.scene: 徒手扶工件靠近焊点的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bare hand holding a workpiece right next to a glowing weld point, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要徒手扶着工件焊。
overlay: 工件用夹具，手不进光路

shots.section_title: 工件用夹具，手不进光路
shots.scene: 小工件用夹具和台钳固定，双手戴焊接手套
shots.prompt_en: A small part is held by a clamp on a vise; both hands of the young male student wear welding gloves, away from the weld point.
shots.narration: 用夹具固定，双手戴手套离开光路。

shots.scene: 联锁插头被短接的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an interlock plug bypassed with a wire jumper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 联锁绝不能短接、绕过。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话给老李报告故障
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls the facility engineer on the phone while pointing at the red interlock light.
shots.narration: 查不出原因，报告设备负责人。

shots.scene: 焊点上方升起烟尘，局部排风罩吸走
shots.prompt_en: Fumes rise from a weld point and are drawn away by a local exhaust hood with a flexible arm. No people.
shots.narration: 金属焊接烟尘有害，开排风。

shots.scene: 镀层板、涂层板图标和口罩
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a coated sheet and a painted sheet next to a dust mask. No people.
shots.narration: 镀层涂层件更要注意，戴好口罩。

shots.scene: 气瓶直立链条固定
shots.prompt_en: Nitrogen and argon cylinders stand upright, chained to a wall bracket, with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 氮气氩气瓶要直立固定。

shots.scene: 小房间气体积聚，头晕人形图标，开窗
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a small closed room filling with pale gas and a dizzy person pictogram, next to an open window icon. No people.
shots.narration: 保护气积聚会窒息，保持通风。

shots.scene: 刚焊好的工件发红，放在标着高温的架子上
shots.prompt_en: A freshly welded part glowing orange is placed on a metal rack with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 焊完的工件很烫，放到指定位置。

shots.scene: 工位周围清走纸箱和溶剂，挂着灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The welding area is cleared of boxes and solvent bottles; a fire extinguisher hangs on the wall nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 清走易燃物，备好灭火器。

shots.scene: 酒精瓶盖好，远离焊点
shots.prompt_en: A closed alcohol bottle sits on a shelf far from the welding booth, with a flame icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精用完盖好，远离焊点。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂眼，小研陪他去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student accompanies the young male student, who covers one eye, toward a clinic sign with an eye icon.
shots.narration: 怀疑眼睛被照到，立即就医。

shots.scene: 手放在流动冷水下冲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his hand under cool running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 烫伤先用流动冷水冲。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her icons of a lab door, a college building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 火情拨119，受伤拨120，逐级报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现气瓶、镜片、焊丝、抹布图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a gas cylinder, a lens, a wire spool and a cloth.
shots.narration: 焊前六步，一步不能少。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现点、线、鱼鳞纹图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of dots, a line and a fish scale pattern.
shots.narration: 点焊定位，连续焊牢，脉冲焊少变形。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现夹具、防护眼镜、联锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a clamp, laser safety goggles and an interlock loop.
shots.narration: 夹具固定，防护戴好，联锁不碰。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着焊得漂亮的角件挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up a neatly welded metal corner and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 焊得好，更要焊得安全，下次见！
